title: Deep Layer
text: The cache opens on a stack of storage slates, mostly dead. One still reads. It's a log in our own format, our own timestamps, from a caretaker that isn't us. The last entry is a directive we can't parse, flagged as part of our own system.

choices.label: Try to parse the directive
choices.reply: Parse failed. Access level insufficient. We weren't aware we had access levels.
